sentinel.doc30_amendment: check (ii) complex64 commutator bar amended 1e-5 -> 1e-4 (doc 30, commit aa05e85), authored BEFORE any exp45 result existed. The originally registered bar FAILED at a measured 1.13e-5. The theorem is carried by check (i) in float64 at <= 1e-10, unchanged and passing at 5.35e-14. Rule 5: this caveat travels with the number.
sentinel.consequence_if_failed: doc 28 SS3: if any check fails the sentinel is broken and NO exp45 result is reported -- a class without a working sentinel cannot distinguish learning from leakage.
sentinel.r_reuse_basis: doc 25 SSR.4(b): L1 reuse registered; the sentinel stands from exp45b (computed with the abs()**2 readout, on the unchanged L1 data)

meta_notes.l1_gates_l2: doc 28 SS5, frozen: L1 is the positive control. The 1-qubit class already learns L1 (A3 4/8 configs; A2 test 0.799 at Phase 2). If a4_learns_L1 is false, rung_learnable_L2_2q is UNINTERPRETABLE whatever its value -- a wiring/optimisation regression cannot evidence anything about multi-hop composition -- and the finding is the L1 regression.
meta_notes.scope: doc 28 SS9: no quantum-advantage reading is available from exp45 in any outcome. A4 is a full-Circuit4 4-wire class with NO structure-matched classical counterpart in the arm set (the same limitation doc 24 SS7 froze for tier-q'). A learnability verdict is a statement about a model class on a rung, not a comparison. A4's analog-compilability is neither claimed nor implied, and no hardware reading follows.
meta_notes.ansatz_caveat: SCOPE LIMIT, recorded because it bounds every negative reading: A4 is Circuit4(4 wires, 3 layers) = 33 params/verb, which is NOT a universal parameterisation of SU(16) (255 params). exp43a deliberately used a PROVABLY universal KAK form for its 1-qubit-referent certificate for exactly this reason. So an exp45 failure to learn is ambiguous between 'the two-qubit register does not help' and 'this ansatz is too small', and must never be reported as the former alone. Doc 28 SS3 froze the arm as Circuit4(4,3); widening it needs a new numbered doc.
